setting: The lab bench kit for Riverside Fabrication, Line 3 (a composite). A DS18B20 stands in for the oven probe, so these limits are chosen for a bench sensor you can warm with your hand, not for an oven.
stale_reason: Same as the Line 3 file: five missed one-second samples.

sensors.label: Bench probe (stands in for the oven)
sensors.reason: A room-temperature bench sits inside 15 to 30 C. Holding the probe in your hand for a minute, or dipping it in warm tap water, carries it above 30 C, so you can make a real alarm happen on purpose and watch it latch. Confirm your room's temperature first and adjust if the bench already reads near a limit.

sensors.label: Press vibration (not wired in the kit)
sensors.reason: Kept from the Line 3 file so the panel layout matches. The bench kit has no vibration sensor, so the service reports a failed read and this tile shows NO DATA. That is the correct display for a sensor that is not there.

sensors.label: Coolant level (not wired in the kit)
sensors.reason: Kept from the Line 3 file so the panel layout matches. The bench kit has no level sensor, so the service reports a failed read and this tile shows NO DATA.
